message.content: The event "I Have a Dream" refers to Martin Luther King Jr.'s speech delivered at the March on Washington on August 28, 1963. "I'll Get You" was released in August 1963 (as the B-side of "She Loves You").
message.reasoning_content: "I Have a Dream" — MLK speech, August 1963. Which song released same month? "She Loves You" Aug 1963 — not an option. Hmm, event: MLK speech Aug 28, 1963. Options... "I'll Get You" released? B-side of "She Loves You," Aug 1963. Yes.
